answer: Every settlement needs two independent auditors, and neither may hold a position in the account it audits. A payoff is valid only when the payer's escrowed ember and the payee's matching entry reconcile inside one window; a lone account witnesses nothing, since a witness needs a counterparty with books of its own. Farmed identities must fund both sides in cash and staff each puppet with a fresh auditor pair; overlapping pairs fail a registry check. Volume buys no discount. Honest agents pay once, then earn velvet tier after a haven review.
